title: Conversational Time Series Foundation Models: Towards Explainable and Effective Forecasting

claim.summary: TSOrchestra uses a fine-tuned language-model judge to iteratively assess constrained ensemble weights over existing forecasting foundation models and explain accept/continue decisions.

modules.name: SFT and GRPO adaptation of the ensemble judge
modules.scope_reason: Qwen is trained on optimization-state decision traces and composite decision/confidence/explanation rewards.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "3.4 R1-Style Fine-tuning for Reasoning and Decision Capability"

modules.name: Forecasting ensemble optimization and continuation control
modules.scope_reason: SLSQP weights and metric selection are optimized for a foundation-model forecast ensemble; the LLM decides whether to continue.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "Therefore, we employ Sequential Least Squares Programming"

modules.name: Weight-optimization audit and reflective explanation
modules.scope_reason: The audit stores ensemble weights, validation metrics, confidence and explanation faithfulness for retrospective interpretation.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "3.5 Interpretability Through Reflective Explanation"
